fusions.name: Saddle Charge
fusions.desc: Charges up to 7 tiles to the target; the blow deals 14 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mounted Barrage
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings at once from the saddle; each one deals 12 damage and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Tireless Wings
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Long Ride
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%, and you carry 8% poison resistance.
